A small ball of mass 0.10kg travels horizontally at a speed of 600m/s. It strikes a stationary
wooden block of mass 1.9kg resting on a frictionless horizontal surface.
The ball stays in the block.
What is the speed of the ball and the block immediately after the impact?
A
30m/s
B
32m/s
C
60m/s
D
130m/s
subject: Physics
